_about: Flixarr quality profiles. Each recipe starts from a TRaSH Guides profile and changes only what's listed. tools/compile.py turns these into profiles.json, the file Flixarr installs download.

profiles.name: Standard
profiles.label: Standard (1080p)
profiles.description: 1080p Bluray and WEB, upgrading to the best 1080p release. No x265 for HD, no remuxes. The default for most libraries.

profiles.name: Space Saver
profiles.label: Space Saver (720p)
profiles.description: 720p Bluray and WEB for smaller files. Same release-quality rules as Standard (no x265 for HD), just a lower resolution.

profiles.name: 4K
profiles.label: 4K
profiles.description: 2160p Bluray and WEB with HDR and Dolby Vision preferred. For 4K screens and plenty of space.

profiles.name: 4K with 1080p fallback
profiles.label: 4K, or 1080p for now
profiles.description: 2160p Bluray and WEB with HDR preferred, but grabs 1080p when no 4K copy exists yet and upgrades to 4K later. For a 4K library that shouldn't wait.

profiles.name: Remux
profiles.label: Remux (1080p)
profiles.description: Untouched 1080p Bluray remuxes, falling back to the best WEB release. The highest quality without 4K, and very large files.

profiles.name: Anime
profiles.label: Anime
profiles.description: Tuned for anime: dual audio and the release groups anime fans prefer, 1080p Bluray, WEB and remuxes.
